rows.question: Show me the photometrically observable star with the color band magnitude i brighter than 19 but fainter than 0, the difference of magnitude g and r is greater than 2.26, the difference of magnitude i and z is less than 0.25, and either the difference of magnitude u and g is greater than 2.0 or the color band magnitude u is fainter than 22.3
rows.pred_sql:
WITH photoobj_clean AS (
  SELECT
    p.objid,
    p.ra,
    p.dec,
    p.u::double precision AS u,
    p.g::double precision AS g,
    p.r::double precision AS r,
    p.i::double precision AS i,
    p.z::double precision AS z,
    p.cmodelmag_u,
    p.cmodelmag_g,
    p.cmodelmag_r,
    p.type,
    p.clean,
    p.extinction_r,
    p.mjd
  FROM photoobj p
),
photo_type_star AS (
  SELECT value
  FROM photo_type
  WHERE name ILIKE '%STAR%'
)
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.u,
  p.g,
  p.r,
  p.i,
  p.z,
  p.cmodelmag_u,
  p.cmodelmag_g,
  p.cmodelmag_r,
  p.type,
  p.clean,
  p.extinction_r,
  p.mjd
FROM photoobj_clean p
JOIN photo_type_star t ON p.type = t.value
WHERE
  -- ensure i is finite and within (0,19)
  p.i IS NOT NULL
  AND NOT (p.i = 'Infinity'::double precision OR p.i = '-Infinity'::double precision)
  AND p.i > 0
  AND p.i < 19
  -- color cuts; NULL-safe arithmetic will yield NULL and fail the comparisons
  AND (p.g - p.r) > 2.26
  AND (p.i - p.z) < 0.25
  AND ( (p.u - p.g) > 2.0 OR p.u > 22.3 )

rows.question: What are the photometrically observable Galaxy whose right ascension is between 140.9 and 141.1, magnitude g is brighter than 18.0 and the difference of magitude u and magnitude g is greater than 2.2. Retrieve the objecti id, right ascension and declination of these objects.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT p.objid,
       p.ra,
       p.dec
FROM photoobj AS p
JOIN photo_type AS t
  ON p.type = t.value
WHERE t.name = 'GALAXY'
  AND p.ra BETWEEN 140.9 AND 141.1
  AND p.g < 18.0
  AND (p.u - p.g) > 2.2

rows.question: Show me the object id, right ascension and declination of photometrically observed Galaxy, of which the the right ascension in a range of from 140.9 to 141.1, the magnitude g is less than 18.0 and the difference of magnitude u and g is higher than 2.2
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT p.objid, p.ra, p.dec
FROM photoobj p
JOIN photo_type pt
  ON p.type = pt.value
WHERE lower(pt.name) = 'galaxy'
  AND p.ra IS NOT NULL
  AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
  AND p.objid IS NOT NULL
  AND p.ra >= 140.9
  AND p.ra <= 141.1
  AND p.g < 18.0
  AND (p.u - p.g) > 2.2

rows.question: Find the object id, right ascension and declination of spectroscopic Galaxy, which have value of magnitude g between 17 and 18 and redshift less than 0.05.
rows.pred_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid AS object_id,
  p.ra,
  p.dec
FROM photoobj p
JOIN specobj s
  ON s.bestobjid = p.objid
WHERE s.class = 'GALAXY'
  AND p.g BETWEEN 17 AND 18
  AND s.z < 0.05
ORDER BY p.objid
